page_text_ocr_zh: 贾政为自己加官进爵，把女儿送入宫中，侍候皇帝。宁、荣两府为贾妃省亲，建造了一座精致、豪华的庭园——大观园。贾妃命宝钗等姐妹搬进园内居住，宝玉也随进去读书。元春在宫里过着牢笼般的生活，终年不见亲人。虽得回家省亲，但是一家人都以君臣之礼相见，得不到天伦之乐。不久，元春便病死宫中。1 贾政原是个御赐额外主事职衔，后来升为员外郎。这一日，正是他的生辰，宁国府的人也齐来庆贺，荣国府中演戏吃酒，热闹非凡。
page_text_en: Jia Zheng, in order to advance his official rank, sent his daughter into the palace to serve the emperor. The Ning and Rong mansions built a magnificent and luxurious garden—Grand View Garden—for the imperial consort's visit. The consort ordered Baochai and her sisters to move into the garden, and Baoyu also went there to study. Yuan Chun lived a caged life in the palace, never seeing her family for years. Although she was allowed to return home to visit her family, they met according to the formalities of ruler and subject, unable to enjoy family happiness. Soon after, Yuan Chun died in the palace. 1 Jia Zheng originally held the imperial-bestowed position of Extraordinary Chief Clerk, later promoted to Minister of the Outer Court. On this day, it was his birthday, and people from the Ning mansion came to celebrate. In the Rong mansion, there were plays and feasting, a scene of great festivity.
summary_zh: 本页文字介绍了贾政为女儿元春加官进爵，元春入宫后的生活及省亲情景，并描述了贾政生辰时宁、荣两府的庆贺场面。插图描绘了贾府众人在庭院中宴饮庆贺的热闹场景。

正在提心吊胆，忽有太监出来传谕，说是贾妃已死了。贾母和王夫人一听，差一点嚎哭出来。
贾娘娘
梦逝。
85
贾政也已得了凶信，在外朝房接着贾母，一路悲切到家。元春就这样死在宫中了。
page_text_en:
84
Just as they were anxiously waiting, a eunuch suddenly came out to announce that Princess Jia had died. Upon hearing this, Grandma Jia and Lady Wang nearly burst into loud sobs.
Princess Jia
Dreams of Death.
85
Jia Zheng had already received the bad news. He met Grandma Jia at the outer court office and escorted her home, grieving all the way. Yuan Chun thus died in the palace.
summary_zh: 贾妃病逝的消息传来，贾母和王夫人悲痛欲绝；贾政接到噩耗后，在外朝房迎接贾母并一同悲痛返家，元春最终死于宫中。
